exposure: Intraoperative findings (large vessels at lower segment, bulge at lower segment, bladder invasion, broad ligament invasion)
outcome: Diagnosis and histopathological classification of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
Correlation of clinical, radiological, and intraoperative findings with histopathological diagnosis
cohort: The study included 43 women with suspected Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who underwent surgical management with hysterectomy.
finding: All 43 women were histopathologically confirmed to have Placenta Accreta Spectrum, with MRI showing a 100% true positive rate for PAS diagnosis, while USG diagnosed or suspected PAS in 79% of cases.
